title: Binary, Images, and Sound
prerequisites: Teacher introduction to the assigned section
objectives: Convert four-bit unsigned values between binary and decimal.
Calculate pixel count and simple uncompressed image size.
Explain how RGB values represent color.
Calculate simple mono sound size and explain quality-size trade-offs.
Save and export reconstructable practice evidence.

requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Complete printed binary, image-size, sound-size, and quality trade-off activities.

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
